text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: After several days and nights of repeatedly soaking and simmering multiple varieties of soybeans, it's finally time for them to become miso!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: My fantastic, newly developed Pearl-brand miso is going to breathe new life into the world of miso paste!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: The possibilities of miso are endless! Ohohoho!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seeking the Pearl becomes so immersed in her miso paste project that she ends up pulling several consecutive all-nighters…
